recap.text: The Guild of Suffering grants membership via a tattoo to anyone who uses its artefacts. Carl asks a voice like a naga's for a map of the Desperado Club's secret passageways, and a swarm of spiders runs up his arm to fill the map with tunnels and drug dens. Katia brings a dead body to the guild to get paid for a job from the Night Wyrm.

Clarabelle tells Carl and Donut they are banned from the Desperado Club by Hamed. Hamed is the Night Wyrm, leader of the Guild of Suffering, husband of the late Astrid, and father of Damascus Steel and Anaconda. He keeps bodyguards with him at all times and airlocked surviving cretins and sai off to the mercenary markets.

beats.headline: Membership arrives with the tattoo
beats.text: The guild worships a demigod, and access is granted by a tattoo that anyone who uses one of its artefacts receives whether or not they went looking for a guild. Mordecai notes, in the tone of a man reading a pamphlet he did not ask for, that it also runs outreach centres.
beats.gist: The Guild of Suffering is a cult that grants membership via tattoos and runs outreach centres.

beats.headline: A map of the secret passages
beats.text: Past the carved door there is only a dark room and a voice like a naga's. It asks Carl whether he wants a job helping the family, and whether he means to kill Katia for the prize. No to both. He wants a map of the Desperado Club's secret passageways. A swarm of spiders runs up his arm, and his map fills: passages and tunnels, some with monsters in them, a hidden potion market on the middle floor, and a scattering of drug dens behind panels in the hallways.
beats.gist: Carl denies a job and killing Katia to a naga-like voice for a map of secret passageways.

beats.headline: She who brings the body
beats.text: The Night Wyrm's messages arrive as a job board would, in his hissing voice. The mark is dead, little sweets; bring her filthy body to the guild, because she who brings the body is she who gets paid. Katia brings it. Job Complete. And then the next line, in the same breath: I have more work for you. Yes, yes, there is always more. Come to me, and we will spread our family's power.
beats.gist: The Night Wyrm offers work to Katia, who gets paid for bringing a dead mark's body.

beats.headline: Hamed takes the club
beats.text: Clarabelle, alive and in her chair, tells Carl and Donut they are banned from the Desperado Club by the new management, who has banned all crawlers for his first few days. He keeps bodyguards with him at all times, not exactly NPCs and not exactly former crawlers, and more security than she has ever seen. The surviving cretins and sai were airlocked off to the mercenary markets. His name is Hamed: the Night Wyrm, leader of the Guild of Suffering, husband of the late Astrid, and father of Damascus Steel and Anaconda, who are supposedly in the club hunting him.
beats.gist: Clarabelle tells Carl and Donut that Hamed, leader of the Guild of Suffering, banned all crawlers.

relations.note: Use the artefact, take the tattoo, and you are a member.
